items.headline: Nvidia permitted for server rack installation on Holger Way
items.summary: A $1.66 million permit was issued for an R&D Lab rack installation at 300 Holger Way, tied to Nvidia's local footprint.

items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A $1.38 million permit was issued for a 5plex condo development at 2820 Florence Avenue, adding new for-sale housing units to the neighborhood.

items.headline: Council weighs legal case against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss a potential legal case involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association. No outcome or further detail was disclosed in the open session.

items.headline: Council to vote on 408 homes on El Camino Real
items.summary: The City Council held a public hearing on annexing and rezoning 451-475 El Camino Real to allow 408 residential units plus a subdivision map, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under state environmental law.
